name: Tight boost for high gain
desc: Low-gain mid-hump boost with a 200 Hz pre-clip cut: tightens a high-gain amp's palm mutes

refs.why: a Tube Screamer in front of the Mesa Mark IIC+ rig
a TS-9 used to push and tighten his high-gain amps

notes: A boost, not a drive: the amp distorts, this only cuts the lows and lifts the mids. Keep it ON in high scenes
